276070024.description: This lot contains assorted rough petrified wood and raw geode stone specimens. The collection features fossilized wood pieces with visible grain structure and coloration from beige to brown. Included are geode-like specimens with crystalline interiors composed of quartz or chalcedony. The stones vary in size, ranging from small to medium hand specimens. All pieces are in natural, unpolished condition with rough, uneven surfaces showing mineral textures and fossilized patterns. Ideal for collectors, educational purposes, or lapidary projects. No brand or model, as these are natural geological specimens.
